title: A school coursework platform whose parts state different access checks
provenance: Synthetic system authored for this corpus (issue #2054, phase 2). Not derived from, or sanitized from, any real system: there is nothing to leak by omission.
notes: The case exists for issue #2054. It measures the assertion pass on the authorization-scope predicates. The source states each part on its own element: the coursework service checks each request against the user's role (each request yes, least privilege yes) and does not check that a submission belongs to the student (ownership no), its database account is limited to three tables (least privilege yes, on that connection), the admin console checks the administrator role only on its start page (each request no), and the grade export's read-only access is a hedge that must stay unknown. The tampering and the information-disclosure must-finds rest on the missing ownership check. The elevation-of-privilege must-find rests on the admin console's start-page-only check across the office network, a privilege zone. The domain is a school, which no other case covers.
